title: Wanderer and the Dragon
description: A lone hooded traveler with a staff walks along a winding path through fields of lavender toward a large glowing sphere containing four stylized faces. In the dark sky above, a massive dragon with spread wings flies near a floating castle, with mountains and a crescent moon in the background.
